verdict.rationale: Gumloop's first-party docs describe scheduled triggers that run agents on a recurring or one-time basis, and the platform overview says agents can be automated with triggers and schedules. Webhook triggers also let an external cron job run an agent. missing for 10: details on schedule granularity or cron-expression support, scheduling via the API/SDK, management of scheduled-run history or failures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
